records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed HTML is posted without sanitization; URL rewriting preserves scripts and event handlers, and the cooking bypass allows malicious HTML to execute on the forum’s origin.
records.rationale: The diff shows imported RSS/remote content is cooked via `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb) and rendered unsanitized with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). No sanitization (e.g. Sanitize) is applied in TopicEmbed.import; the readability call whitelists only benign tags for extraction, but poll_feed passes feed `i.content` directly. Malicious HTML/script in feed or imported page content would be stored and executed on the forum origin.
